title: Gain work experience
subtitle: 獲得實務經驗、累積專業經驗、親身操作、接觸職場、取得行業經驗——究竟是哪一種 gain work experience？
description: 獲得實務經驗、累積專業經驗、親身操作、接觸職場、取得行業經驗——究竟是哪一種 gain work experience？

words.meaning: 獲得實際經驗；累積實務經驗
words.note: 透過實際工作、實習、項目或現場操作取得真實經驗。

exercises.original: Students can gain work experience through summer placements.
exercises.zh: 這句描述透過實際工作或職場參與取得經驗。
exercises.upgrade: acquire practical experience · 獲得實際經驗；累積實務經驗

options.explanation: — acquire practical experience = 透過實際工作、實習、項目或現場操作取得真實經驗。 本句的實際參與程度與目標語義吻合。
— 接受培訓；可能有助能力發展，但不等於真實工作經驗。 因此不等同本題的工作經驗累積。
— 取得資格／證書；是 credential，不是 experience。 因此是資格而非工作經驗。
— 學習理論；沒有真實職場參與。 因此缺少實際職場參與。
— 跟隨觀察；提供 exposure，但 hands-on responsibility 通常較少。 只有在本題重點是初步 workplace exposure 時才更合適。
— 取得職位；真正經驗要在之後的工作中累積。 因此它是進入工作的起點，而不是累積後的 experience。

falseSynonyms.zh: 找到工作不等於累積經驗 得到職位只是開始；之後的實際工作才形成 experience。
falseSynonyms.point: Getting a job creates an opportunity to gain work experience.
Training can prepare someone for work, but it may happen without real workplace responsibility. Training prepares you for work; work experience comes from participation.
A degree or certificate records learning or competence, not workplace experience. A person can have strong qualifications but little work experience.

falseSynonyms.zh: 實習是途徑，不是經驗本身
falseSynonyms.point: An internship is a placement through which experience may be gained. An internship can provide practical work experience.
Volunteering can generate useful experience, but the activity itself is not identical to experience. Volunteering can provide practical experience.
A placement is the arrangement; work experience is what the learner gains from it. A work placement gives students an opportunity to gain experience.
Job shadowing often gives workplace exposure rather than substantial hands-on experience. Job shadowing provides exposure, but not always hands-on responsibility.
Employment is being employed; experience is the knowledge and competence accumulated through work. Employment can lead to work experience over time.
